description: P0.0 baseline and gap packet for Prow/cloud-ci enforcement plus tenant-isolation fixtures. This file is evidence of the current P0.0 state, not a Phase-0 completion claim.

external_best_practice_evidence.used_for: Prow decomposition: hook/job lifecycle/status reporting/Tide/branchprotector reference shape.
Tide manages merge pools, retests PRs against latest base, maintains status contexts, and supports branch/repo merge blocking.
Protected branches require named status checks and can bind an expected status-check source app.
Tenant isolation uses tenant context to block cross-tenant resource access and is separate from generic authentication/authorization.
